## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Rúlái shìjiào shèngjūn wáng jīng* (T515) is a one-fascicle Tang translation by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng. The protagonist *Shèngjūn wáng* 勝軍王 ("King Conquering-Army"; Sanskrit *Prasenajit*) is the famous king of Kosala, longtime patron of the Buddha. The text is parallel to [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Shīhù's later *Fóshuō shèngjūn wáng suǒwèn jīng* [KR6i0146](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0146) (T516).

**Abstract**

A Mahāyāna text on the Buddha's teaching to King Prasenajit on royal Buddhist conduct. Xuánzàng's translation idiom (post-645 CE Cíēn-school polished Yogācāra Chinese) is evident. Translation falls within Xuánzàng's post-return productive period (645–664 CE).
